# Retest results

<!-- generated by `failbook report`; do not edit by hand -->

Each cell is *passed / graded attempts* for the current version of the case: attempts whose agent run completed and that the grader could decide. ✅ all passed, ⚠️ some passed, ❌ none passed, ❔ no attempt could be graded. Attempts that were not graded are listed by reason and never counted as failures: `inconclusive` (the grader could not decide), `timeout`, `agent-error` and `not-run` (the agent run did not complete: an agent or environment problem, see `run_status`). How results are produced and submitted: [results/README.md](results/README.md).

There is deliberately no overall score or ranking. The cases are a curated set of known failure patterns, not a sample of real work, so a pass count across cases says nothing about how reliable an agent is in general (see [docs/DATASHEET.md](docs/DATASHEET.md)).

**No retest results have been submitted yet.** The failure artifacts shipped with each case are reconstructions (see each case's provenance), not measurements of any particular model.

Be the first: run `failbook run --agent <preset> --model <name>`, or record a run made with any other tool with `failbook grade --record` (see [results/README.md](results/README.md)), and open a pull request with the files written to `results/`.
